title: The Cipher of Saint Alder's
author: Beatrix Joubert
blurb: Sable Fairweather, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
